annotation.title_clean: 貨物自動車運送事業法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Enforcement Regulations of the Motor Truck Transportation Business Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance implementing the Motor Truck Transportation Business Act, specifying licensing, business plans, documents, tariffs and procedures for trucking operators. It includes limited provisions on automated-operation freight transport (automatic operation devices, specific automated operation) in business plans and application documents. Revised effective 1 April 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Business plans must state vehicles allocated to automated-operation freight transport
Applicants for specific automated operation freight must submit copies of Road Traffic Act permit applications
Documents must state operating conditions of automatic operation devices
Rules on permits, fares, contracts, actual-carrier management ledgers, and mergers
